findings.summary: The computed title helper carries a legacy branch for a value only consumed by the embed iframe.
findings.consequence: This adds a small reactive indirection and an impossible legacy return path without enforcing a policy beyond string formatting.
findings.evidence: `frameTitle` is defined on lines 29-30, but the only consumer is the iframe title in the embed-only template branch at line 101; the legacy branch never renders that iframe.
findings.recommendation: Inline the embed title at the iframe binding or replace this with a non-reactive helper that accepts the embed word, eliminating the legacy fallback path.
